description: A spelling bee with spoken words — hear the word, read its definition, then spell it correctly.

faqs.a: Your browser reads the word aloud with speech synthesis — press the speaker button to hear it again.
faqs.q: How do I hear the word?

faqs.a: Every word shows its definition as a clue, just like a real spelling bee.
Each correct spelling scores 10 points plus a streak bonus; wrong spellings reset the streak.
60 words from easy to tricky, asked in random order without repeats.

howto: Press Start, then 🔊 to hear the word.
Type the spelling and press Enter.
Streaks earn bonus points — spell them all!
title: Spelling Bee Game
